gloss: dancing for joy; jumping for joy

definitions.gloss: dancing for joy; jumping for joy
definitions.explanation: Jumping up and down with delight; being overjoyed. Usually in {小躍|こおど}りして{喜|よろこ}ぶ (to jump for joy), whether literally or as a figure of speech for great happiness.

examples.japanese: ⟦{合格|ごうかく}→合格：02816_goukaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{知|し}らせ→知らせ：03252_shirase⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{小躍|こおど}り⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I jumped for joy at the news that I had passed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{雪|ゆき}→雪：00584_yuki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧{小躍|こおど}り⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{喜|よろこ}んだ→喜ぶ：01169_yorokobu⟧。
examples.english: The children danced for joy when they saw the snow.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{認|みと}められ→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧、⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{思|おも}わ→思う：00492_omou⟧ず{小躍|こおど}り⟦したい→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{気持|きも}ち→気持ち：02485_kimochi⟧になった。
examples.english: His years of research were recognized, and he felt like dancing for joy.

notes:
⟦{小|こ}→小〜：00240_ko⟧ (small) + ⟦{躍|おど}り→躍る：31959_odoru⟧ (leaping): small hops of delight. Written language and storytelling more than conversation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {小躍|こおど}り⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{喜|よろこ}ぶ→喜ぶ：01169_yorokobu⟧: to jump for joy
- {小躍|こおど}り⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to dance with delight
- {小躍|こおど}り⟦したい→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{気分|きぶん}→気分：01306_kibun⟧: feel like dancing for joy

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{喜|よろこ}ぶ→喜ぶ：01169_yorokobu⟧: to be glad; the general verb
- ⟦{躍|おど}る→躍る：31959_odoru⟧: (of the heart) to leap, as in ⟦{胸|むね}→胸：00972_mune⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{躍|おど}る→躍る：31959_odoru⟧
